It may also be used as a term of endearment or respect towards an individual who embodies the qualities of Kamadeva, such as charm, attraction, and enchantment.

It represents the deep longing within us for connection, fulfillment, and joy. The name Kamraj is a reminder of the divine power of love that exists within us and in the universe.
